scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:backend:app && npm run test:services
scripts.test:backend:app: cd backend && AFTERGLOW_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 uv run python -m pytest tests/ -v --ignore=tests/integration
scripts.test:backend:integration: cd backend && AFTERGLOW_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 uv run python -m pytest tests/integration -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test:target:js && npm run test:backend:app && npm run test:services && npm run test:backend:integration && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:services: uv run --project services/waygate --extra dev python -m pytest services/waygate/tests -v && uv run --project services/waygate/sdk --extra dev python -m pytest services/waygate/sdk/tests -v && uv run --project services/drover --extra dev python -m pytest services/drover/tests -v && uv run --project services/drover/sdk --extra dev python -m pytest services/drover/sdk/tests -v && uv run --project services/lumen --extra dev python -m pytest services/lumen/tests -v && uv run --project services/lumen/sdk --extra dev python -m pytest services/lumen/sdk/tests -v
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:backend:fix: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && git add backend/pyproject.toml backend/uv.lock frontend/package.json package.json
